---
name: Skill request
about: Propose a new audit skill, or a new check inside an existing one
title: "Skill request: "
labels: enhancement
---

**New skill or existing skill?**
New skill `/proposed-name`, or a new check inside `/existing-skill` (link the file).

**Audit domain**
What it audits and who it is for (one paragraph).

**One concrete example finding it should catch**
The kind of problem, where it lives (code / SQL / config / infra), and what the fix-kit prompt for it would look like.

**Overlap check**
Which existing skills come closest, and why they don't cover this.

**Tools it would need**
Stock Claude Code only, or an MCP server (Supabase, Cloudflare, Playwright...) / CLI?
